name: A creature card in a graveyard with a keyword gives that keyword
notes: Cairn Wanderer: "As long as a creature card with flying is in a graveyard, this creature has flying. The same is true for …"; Bleeding Effect's trigger: "… gain flying until end of turn if a creature card in your graveyard has flying. The same is true for …". The opponent's graveyard has Serra Angel (flying, vigilance), yours Craw Wurm and Giant Spider (reach): Cairn Wanderer has flying, vigilance and reach, not trample; Bleeding Effect gives your creatures reach only (Serra Angel is not in your graveyard).
